title: 429 rate_limit_error that retries never clear because the monthly API spend limit was reached
symptoms: 429 rate_limit_error: You have reached your API usage limits
No retry-after header, and the SDK's automatic retries fail every time
cause: When an organization crosses the monthly usage threshold for its tier, the API answers with the same error type as a rate limit, but access stays blocked until the reset time in the message or a tier change.
fix: Read error.details.error_code before backing off. On enforced_spend_limit_reached stop retrying, alert someone, and raise the tier or the spend limit in the Console.
